def run(k):
    inp,out=G[f'Demo pair {k} input'],G[f'Demo pair {k} output']
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    colored=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if inp[i][j]==0 and out[i][j]==2]
    seed=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if inp[i][j]==2][0]
    eights=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if inp[i][j]==8]
    pts=seed+eights
    res=[]
    for (i,j) in colored:
        hit=False
        for quad in itertools.combinations(pts,4):
            r1,c1,r2,c2=quad[0]; q_1=quad[1][0]; q_2=quad[1][1]
            (r1_,c1_),(r2_,c2_)=(r1,c1),(r2,c2)
            # rect defined by these two pairs... simpler: check all pairs as opposite corners
            rs=sorted({r1_,r2_,q_1,r2_}); cs=sorted({c1_,c2_,q_1,q_2})

            if not (min(rs)<=i<=max(rs) and min(cs)<=j<=max(cs)): continue
            # on border: row==top/bottom or col==left/right
            on = (i in (rs[0],rs[-1])) or (j in (cs[0],cs[-1]))
            if on: hit=True; break
        res.append((i,j,'ok' if hit else 'BAD'))
    print(k, sum(1 for x in res if x[2]=='BAD'), '/', len(colored))
    return res

from collections import deque
def analyze(k):
    inp=G[f'Demo pair {k} input']; out=G[f'Demo pair {k} output']
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    ch={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if out[i][j]==2 and inp[i][j]!=2}
    bands=[r for r in range(H) if any(x==8 for x in inp[r])]
    seeds=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if inp[i][j]==2]
    # For each painted cell: distances to nearest 8 up/down/left/right (steps until 8 or edge)
    feats=[]
    for (i,j) in sorted(ch):
        d={}
        for name,axis in [('U',0),('D',1),('L',2),('R',3)]:
            n=0; v=None
            rr,cc=i-(1 if axis==0 else 0), j+(0 if axis==0 else 1)
            while True:
                n+=1
                if not(0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W) or inp[rr][cc]==8: break
                rr+=(1 if axis==0 else 0); cc+=(1 if axis==2 else 1)
            d[name]=n
        feats.append((d,i,j,inp[i][j]=='2'))
    # check predicate candidates
    res=[]
    for d,i,j,_ in feats:
        res.append((d['U'],d['D'],d['L'],d['R']))
    from collections import Counter
    uniq=Counter(res)
    print(k,'painted cells:',len(ch),'unique (U,D,L,R) distance tuples:',uniq.most_common())
    # also unpainted 0-cells adjacent features sample
analyze(1); analyze(2); analyze(3)

def rays(a,r,c,dr,dc):
    h=len(a); w=len(a[0]); rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc; n=0
